content.zh: 那是肚子在“按摩”呢！我们的肠胃在用力挤压，把食物和空气推来推去，这种肠胃蠕动（Peristalsis）发出的声音，就是肚子在咕咕叫啦。
content.en: Your tummy is giving itself a massage! Your stomach and intestines squeeze to push food and air around. This movement, called Peristalsis, makes the rumbling sound.

title.en: Why do cuts form a scab?

content.zh: 血液里有神奇的“建筑工人”（血小板 Platelets），它们会手拉手堵住伤口，变硬后形成一块“天然创可贴”（结痂），保护下面的新皮肤慢慢长出来。
content.en: Your blood has tiny builders called Platelets. They hold hands to plug the cut and form a hard natural bandage (a scab), protecting the new skin growing underneath.

content.zh: 当大脑工作累了或者有点热的时候，打哈欠是为了深吸一大口气，给大脑降降温、加加油，让我们重新清醒起来！
content.en: When our brain is tired or a bit warm, yawning helps us take a deep breath to cool the brain down and wake it back up!

content.zh: 不是哦！虽然骨头里面没有空气，但它们比钢铁还要坚硬（Bone Strength）。不过骨头里面住着骨髓（Bone Marrow），它是我们身体制造血液的超级工厂！
content.en: No! Bones aren't hollow, and they are actually stronger than steel! Inside the bones lives Bone Marrow, which is a super factory that makes our blood.

title.en: Do we lose skin every day?

content.zh: 是的！我们的身体就像一件神奇的外衣，每天都在悄悄脱落死去的皮肤细胞（Skin Cells）。我们每天掉落的皮屑，其实都是身体在换新衣服呢！
content.en: Yes! Our body is like a magic coat. We shed dead Skin Cells every day. Those tiny flakes are just our body putting on a brand new coat!
